cycle_envelopes.reason: Authentication, authorization, notifications, and extension initialization still share model and bootstrap dependencies.
cycle_envelopes.exit_plan: Introduce explicit application events and move extension/bootstrap imports out of domain modules. The envelope may shrink, but no new domain may join it.

cycle_envelopes.reason: The integration cutover still has reciprocal imports between provider web modules and the canonical integration runtime.
cycle_envelopes.exit_plan: Move Prometheus and Alertmanager provider ownership under canonical integration provider packages and keep web routes as one-way adapters.
